figures.before: OSHA 1926 Overview: The Primary Federal Construction Safety Standard and How Florida Enforces It
figures.alt: Concrete pour preparation with rebar, vapor barrier, edge forms, and a clean ready-to-place slab area
figures.caption: Safety on a construction site is built into planning and field control: competent supervision, task sequencing, equipment, access, housekeeping, trade coordination, inspections, and the conditions before work starts.

figures.before: Excavation and Trenching Safety in Florida: Sandy Soil Type C Classification, Trench Box Requirements, Groundwater
figures.alt: Industrial site grading with a stormwater basin, controlled slopes, compacted subgrade, and clear perimeter access
figures.caption: Earthwork conditions change quickly with soil, water, weather, access, equipment, and the excavation plan. The work area has to be assessed and controlled before crews enter or work around it.

figures.before: Written Safety Plans Required on Florida Construction Projects
figures.alt: Construction planning table with drawings, measuring tools, a blank clipboard, and coordination materials
figures.caption: A workable safety plan connects the project’s actual hazards to responsibilities, site logistics, training, inspections, emergency response, trade coordination, and documentation that can be acted on in the field.
